description: Read open times from a clinic's own online scheduler, by practice_slug, for one service_id between date_from and date_to (the clinic's dates, both included, at most 14 days). Each time carries starts_at, start_local (the time at the clinic) and time_zone, and earliest is the first one; preferred_time puts the closest times first. Where Xona books the clinic's scheduler (an option public_provider_booking), a chosen time goes to choose_public_booking_time with its id as slot_id, its service_id and starts_at; otherwise the patient books it on the clinic's own page, the link prepare_dental_practice_action gives with capability public_booking_handoff.

inputSchema.description: Read at most 14 days of availability, starting no more than 180 days ahead.

date_from.description: First day to read, in the clinic's time zone; today or later

date_to.description: Last day to read (inclusive), at most 13 days after date_from

preferred_time.description: The patient's preferred local start time, 24-hour HH:MM; the closest times come first

service_id.description: A service_id from list_public_booking_services, or from a soonest search row's services

name: list_public_booking_slots
title: List a clinic's public booking slots
